  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 4px 0;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.subt .s:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: var(--border-strong);
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.subt .due {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.att {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}
.attc {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r);
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  background: var(--surface);
  position: relative;
}
.attc .fprev {
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
}
.attc .fprev .art {
  inset: 10px 14px;
  padding: 7px;
  gap: 4px;
}
.attc .fi {
  padding: 7px 9px;
}
.attc .x {
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px;
  right: 5px;
  opacity: 0;
  background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
}
.attc:hover .x {
  opacity: 1;
}
.cmt {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 0;
}
.cmt .body {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.cmt .who {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
}
.cmt .who b {
  font-weight: 600;
}
.cmt .who time {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.cmt .txt {
  font-size: var(--fs);
  margin-top: 3px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-wrap: break-word;
}
.mention {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 500;
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  padding: 0 3px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.reacts {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-top: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.react {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  height: 22px;
  padding: 0 7px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  background: var(--surface);
  transition:
    background var(--dur),
    border-color var(--dur);
}
.react:hover {
  background: var(--surface-2);
}
.react.mine {
  border-color: var(--accent-line);
  background: var(--accent-soft);
}
.cbox {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r);
  padding: 8px 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur),
    box-shadow var(--dur);
  background: var(--surface);
}
.cbox:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft);
}
.cbox textarea {
  border: 0;
  outline: 0;
  resize: none;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: var(--fs);
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.act-line {
  display: flex;
  gap: 9px;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  color: var(--text-2);
  padding: 5px 0;
}
.act-line b {
  color: var(--text);
  font-weight: 500;
}
.act-line .ico {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--text-4);
}

.pop {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 80;
  min-width: 200px;
  max-width: 320px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  padding: 4px;
  transform-origin: top left;
  max-height: min(420px, 70vh);
  overflow-y: auto;
  font-size: var(--fs);
}
@keyframes popIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-4px) scale(0.97);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
.pop.enter {
  animation: popIn 0.16s var(--ease) both;
}
.pop .pin {
  padding: 4px 4px 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
  margin: -4px -4px 4px;
  padding: 8px;
}
.pop .pin input {
  border: 0;
  outline: 0;
  background: transparent;
  width: 100%;
  font-size: var(--fs);
  padding: 0 4px;
}
.mi {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 30px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  text-align: left;
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: var(--fs);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.mi:hover,
.mi.hl,
.mi:focus-visible {
  background: var(--surface-2);
  outline: none;
}
.mi .i {
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.mi .r {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  align-items: center;
}
.mi .ck {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--accent);
}
.mi.danger {
  color: var(--red);
}
.mi.danger .i {
  color: var(--red);
}
.mi:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.msep {
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--divider);
  margin: 4px -4px;
}
.mh {
  font-size: var(--fs-2xs);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-3);
  padding: 8px 8px 4px;
}
/* Filter builder uses the same insets as every other menu: 4px popover padding + 8px item padding. */
.fbuild {
  min-width: 440px;
}
.fb-h {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  min-height: 30px;
  padding-top: 4px;
  padding-bottom: 4px;
}
.fb-h .btn {
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  margin-right: -4px;
}
.fb-rows {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 2px 8px 6px;
}
.fb-empty {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 2px 8px 8px;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  color: var(--text-3);
}
.fb-add {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 4px 8px 6px;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.fb-add .faint {
  margin-right: 4px;
}
.frow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 44px 120px 84px minmax(0, 1fr) 26px;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: center;
}
.frow .conj {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-3);
  text-align: right;
  padding-right: 4px;
}
.frow .select,
.frow .input {
  height: var(--h-sm);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
}
.valbtn {
  height: var(--h-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  padding: 0 8px;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  text-align: left;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--surface);
}
.valbtn:hover {
  background: var(--surface-2);
}

.palette {
  position: fixed;
  top: 12vh;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: min(640px, calc(100vw - 32px));
  background: var(--surface);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  z-index: 90;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 70vh;
}
.pal-in {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  height: 50px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.pal-in input {
  flex: 1;
  border: 0;
  outline: 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  height: 100%;
}
.pal-scope {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.pal-scope button {
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0 9px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}
.pal-scope button.on {
  background: var(--text);
  color: var(--text-inv);
  border-color: var(--text);
}
.pal-list {
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 6px;
  flex: 1;
}
.pal-sec {
  font-size: var(--fs-2xs);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-3);
  padding: 10px 10px 4px;
}
.pal-sec + .pi {
  margin-top: 0;
}
.pal-group {
  padding-bottom: 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.pal-group:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.pi {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: var(--fs);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.pi.hl {
  background: var(--surface-2);
}
.pi .i {
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.pi .sub {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  margin-left: 4px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.pi .r {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.pi mark {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.pal-f {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-3);
  background: var(--sunken);
}
.pal-f span {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 5px;
  align-items: center;
}

#toasts {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 20px;
  right: 20px;
  z-index: 100;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: flex-end;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.toast {
  pointer-events: auto;
  animation-timing-function: var(--spring) !important;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 8px 8px 8px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r);
  background: var(--text);
  color: var(--text-inv);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  animation: toastIn 0.2s var(--ease) both;
  max-width: 400px;
}
.toast.out {
  animation: toastOut 0.16s ease both;
}
.toast .i.ok {
  color: var(--green);
}
.toast .i.bad {
  color: var(--red);
}
.toast .ta {
  color: var(--text-inv);
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  opacity: 0.9;
}
.toast .ta:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-inv) 14%, transparent);
}
@keyframes toastIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(14px) scale(0.96);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes toastOut {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(4px);
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   STATES: EMPTY / SKELETON / ERROR
   ============================================================ */
.empty-state {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 56px 24px;
  gap: 6px;
}
.empty-state .glyph {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--text-4);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.empty-state .glyph svg {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
}
.empty-state .es-h {
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0;
}
.empty-state p {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  max-width: 340px;
}
.empty-state.sm {

}
.empty-state.err .glyph {

}
.sk {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--surface-3) 0%, var(--surface-2) 45%, var(--surface-3) 90%);

}
@keyframes shimmer {

    background-position: 120% 0;

}
.alert {

}

}
.alert.warn {

  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.warn .i {
  color: var(--amber);
}
.alert.danger {
  background: var(--red-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.danger .i {
  color: var(--red);
}
.alert.info {
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.info .i {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.alert.ok {
  background: var(--green-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.ok .i {
  color: var(--green);
}
.alert b {
  font-weight: 600;
}
.fullstate {

  place-items: center;

}
.fullstate .box {

  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;

}
.fullstate .code {

}
.fullstate h1 {

  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}
.fullstate p {
  color: var(--text-2);

.set-nav {

}

.set-body {

}
.set-in {

   AUTH / ONBOARDING
   ============================================================ */

.glyph-g,

.link {

}
.link:hover {

.auth-foot {

.strength {

.opts {

.opt {

.opt:hover {

}
.opt.on {

}
.opt .i {

}
.opt.on .i {

}
.opt b {

}
.opt span {

}
.tmpls {

}
.iconpick {

}
.iconpick button {

  border-radius: var(--r-sm);

  place-items: center;

}
.iconpick button:hover {

}
.iconpick button.on {

/* design system page */
.ds-sec {

}
.ds-sec > h2 {

.ds-sec > h2 span {

}
.ds-grid {

  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));

}
.ds-tok {

  border-radius: var(--r);
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.ds-tok .c {

  background: var(--c);

}
.ds-tok .n {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.ds-tok .n code {

}
.ds-row {

.ds-row .lab {

}
.state-hover {

}
.btn-primary.state-hover {

}
.btn-primary.state-active {

}
.state-focus {

}
.states-grid {

}
.states-grid .panel {

}
.states-grid .cap {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-weight: 500;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--sunken);
}
/* ============================================================
   MOTION: one-shot flow animations (gated to the render they belong to)
   ============================================================ */
@keyframes riseIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes slideInR {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(18px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes growX {
  from {
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }
}
@keyframes popCheck {
  0% {
    transform: scale(0.55);
  }
  55% {
    transform: scale(1.2);
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}
@keyframes strike {
  to {
    background-size: 100% 1.5px;
  }
}
@keyframes doneWash {
  from {
    background: var(--green-soft);
  }
  to {
    background: transparent;
  }
}
@keyframes doneRing {
  from {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 2px var(--green),
      var(--shadow-card);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
@keyframes land {
  0% {
    transform: scale(1.04) rotate(-1.2deg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-drag);
  }
  100% {
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
@keyframes addWash {
  from {
    background: var(--accent-soft);
  }
  to {
    background: transparent;
  }
}
@keyframes addRing {
  from {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 2px var(--accent-line),
      var(--shadow-card);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
/* route change: content rises in, lightly staggered */
.fx-route > .page > *,
.fx-route > .fullstate {
  animation: riseIn 0.36s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.035s;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.07s;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.1s;
}
.fx-route .grid2 > * > *:nth-child(2),
.fx-route .grid2 > *:nth-child(2) > *:first-child {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s 0.09s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .prog > i {
  animation: growX 0.8s 0.12s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .stackbar i {
  transform-origin: left;
  animation: growX 0.8s 0.12s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .bar {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.pbody.fx-tab > * {
  animation: riseIn 0.26s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .kcard {
  animation: riseIn 0.32s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(2) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.03s;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(3) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.06s;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(n + 4) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.09s;
}
/* task completed */
.trow.fx-done,
.mini.fx-done {
  animation: doneWash 1s var(--ease) both;
}
.kcard.fx-done {
  animation: doneRing 1s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-done .check,
.fx-done .done-ic {
  animation: popCheck 0.42s var(--spring) both;
}
.fx-done .tt,
.fx-done .title {
  text-decoration: none !important;
  background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 0 58%/0 1.5px no-repeat;
  animation: strike 0.38s 0.1s var(--ease) forwards;
}
/* dropped, created */
.kcard.fx-moved {
  animation: land 0.5s var(--spring) both;
}
.cev.fx-moved,
.wcard.fx-moved {
  animation: popCheck 0.4s var(--spring) both;
}
.trow.fx-added,
.mini.fx-added {
  animation:
    riseIn 0.3s var(--ease) both,
    addWash 1.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.kcard.fx-added {
  animation:
    riseIn 0.3s var(--ease) both,
    addRing 1.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.subt.fx-added {
  animation: riseIn 0.28s var(--ease) both;
}
/* auth + onboarding */
.auth-card.fx-auth > * {
  animation: riseIn 0.42s var(--ease) both;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.04s;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.08s;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.12s;
}
.onb.fx-step > *:not(.steps) {
  animation: slideInR 0.36s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.05s;
}
.steps i {
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: background 0.3s;
}
.onb.fx-step .steps i.cur {
  animation: growX 0.45s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.12s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.24s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row .ok {
  animation: popCheck 0.42s var(--spring) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(1) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.18s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(2) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.3s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(3) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.42s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-badge {
  animation: popCheck 0.5s 0.05s var(--spring) both;
}
/* tactile micro-feedback */
.check:active {
  transform: scale(0.88);
}
.check {
  transition:
    background var(--dur),
    border-color var(--dur),
    transform 0.12s var(--ease);
}
.toggle::after {
  transition: transform 0.28s var(--spring);
}
.pcard {
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur),
    box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease),
    transform 0.2s var(--ease);
}
.pcard:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.kcard {
  transition:
    box-shadow var(--dur),
    transform 0.18s var(--ease);
}
.kcard:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.stat .v {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .fx-route > .page > *,
  .fx-route > .fullstate,
  .fx-route .grid2 > * > *,
  .fx-route .bar,
  .pbody.fx-tab > *,
  .pbody.fx-tab .kcard,
  .auth-card.fx-auth > *,
  .onb.fx-step > *,
  .drawer.enter .drawer-b > *,
  .kcard.fx-moved,
  .cev.fx-moved,
  .wcard.fx-moved,
  .fx-done .check,
  .onb.fx-step .ready-row,
  .onb.fx-step .ready-row .ok,
  .onb.fx-step .ready-badge {
    animation: fadeOnly 0.12s both !important;
  }
  .fx-route .prog > i,
  .fx-route .stackbar i,
  .onb.fx-step .steps i.cur {
    animation: none !important;
  }
  .fx-done .tt,
  .fx-done .title {
    animation: none;
    background: none;
    text-decoration: line-through !important;
  }
  .pcard:hover,
  .kcard:hover,
  .check:active {
    transform: none;
  }

@media (max-width: 900px) {

  .shell.collapsed {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .side {
    position: fixed;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;

    transform: none;
  }
  .shell.collapsed .side .sitem {
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding: 0 8px;
  }
  .side-scrim {
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: var(--overlay);

    animation: fade 0.14s both;
  }
  :root {
    --gutter: 16px;
  }
  .page {
    padding: 20px var(--gutter) 96px;
  }
  .stats {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .stat:nth-child(3) {

  }
  .set {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .set-nav {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;

    padding: 8px 12px;

  .tl {

  }
  .board {
    padding-bottom: 90px;
  }
  .proj-h {
    padding-top: 16px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  :root {
    --topbar-h: 50px;
  }
  .bottomnav {
    display: flex;
    position: fixed;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 45;
    background: var(--surface);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 4px 6px calc(4px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }
  .bottomnav button {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 5px 0;

    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-3);
    border-radius: var(--r-sm);
    position: relative;
  }
  .bottomnav button.on {
    color: var(--text);
  }
  .bottomnav .bdot {
    position: absolute;
    top: 3px;
    left: calc(50% + 6px);
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
    border-radius: 50%;

  }
  .hide-m {
    display: none !important;
  }
  .ph h1 {
    font-size: var(--fs-xl);
  }
  .ph .acts {
    margin-left: 0;
    width: 100%;
  }
  /* list & table become stacked cards */
  .list-wrap {
    padding-left: var(--gutter);
  }
  .tlist .thead {
    display: none;
  }
  .tlist .trow {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px 6px;
    padding: 10px 6px;
    min-height: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--r);
    margin: 6px 0;
  }
  .tlist .trow > div {
    padding: 0;
  }
  .tlist .trow .handle {
    display: none;
  }
  .tlist .trow .ttl {
    flex: 1 1 calc(100% - 30px);

    order: 0;
  }

    order: 2;
  }

    display: none;
  }

  .drawer.full {

    left: 0;

    bottom: 0;

  }

  }

  }

  .tmpls {

  }
  .themecards {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .fbuild {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .frow {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
  .frow .conj {
    display: none;
  }
  .cal-g {
    grid-auto-rows: minmax(72px, 1fr);
  }
  .cev .trunc,
  .cev .av {
    display: none;
  }
  .cev {
    height: 8px;
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: var(--c);
  }
  .week {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  .wcol {
    border-right: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .tl-left {
    display: none;
  }
  .tl {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  #toasts {
    left: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    bottom: 76px;

  }
  .kv {
    grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .srow {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .topsearch {
    border: 0;

    width: var(--h-md);

  .crumbs button:not(.cur),

  .panel-h {

  }
  .panel-h h2 {

  }
  .topbar .ibtn,
  .topbar .btn,
  .topsearch {
    min-width: 40px;
